full_name: Jennifer Finney Boylan | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2022–2023 Fiction & Poetry Marilyn Beaudry-Corbett Schlesinger Fellow Barnard College
bio: Jennifer Finney Boylan is the author of 16 books, a trustee of PEN America, and the inaugural Anna Quindlen Writer in Residence at Barnard College of Columbia University.
